input.explanation: No. The fix is complete inside this repository. The crash was in average_spend_per_item_this_month in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py. With the patch, that function returns 0 when a shopper has made no purchases this month. Before, it divided by zero. render_spend_summary and account_page._the_figure_for call it exactly as before and get an int back, so with monthly-spend-feature on, those shoppers now get a rendered page rather than a failed request. The flag system, the deploy config and other services don't need to change.
